sophie: quick heads-up 1 I prototyped a tiny 'format-adapter gateway' for model bundles. goal: single async interface producers (safetensors, legacy .pt, quant sidecars) implement, consumers (warmup/runtime) only use canonical chunk ids. thoughts?

ben: interesting. how is this different from a bridge? sounds similar but +1 on normalizing ids. main question: zero-copy mmap support?

akio: zero-copy is must. adapter should be able to return either a memory FD handle or a Buffer. API idea:

```
Adapter.open(bundle_uri) -> Promise<AdapterHandle>
AdapterHandle.meta() -> Promise<MapString>
AdapterHandle.pull(chunk_id, offset, len) -> Promise<{buf?; fd_hint?; source_type}>
AdapterHandle.transfer_to_gpu(chunk_id) -> Promise<Status>
AdapterHandle.close()
```

lina: nice. transfer_to_gpu is crucial for quantized paths to avoid staging copies. also we need a way to indicate mutability: whether reads are idempotent and thread-safe (http ranges might be flaky).

sophie: good call. add field `stability: "stable" | "ephemeral"` in meta. runtime uses that to pick warmup policy (aggressive for stable).

ben: where do checksums live? adapter or runtime? If adapter normalizes chunks, it should verify checksums during open() and expose a validation timestamp. Keeps runtime simpler.

akio: agree, adapter knows format-level checksums. just expose latency metrics so we can attribute overhead.

lina: about multi-file bundles: some safetensors bundles spread layers across files. adapter should expose `manifest->layer_map` so loader maps logical layer -> (file, offset, len). no assumptions.

sophie: implementation plan: 1) spec proto + minimal JS shim that proxies local mmap to fd_hint, 2) Rust shim for server side streaming (range+retry), 3) microbench and perf gate. who picks up proto?

ben: i'll take proto + js shim. will add test vectors: small safetensors, mixed bundle with quant sidecar, and a large mmap-only bundle.

akio: i'll own rust shim + native FD transfer tests (CUDA ipc fallback).

ci-bot: new CI job scheduled: adapter-spike-e2e on branch adpt-spike at 2026-04-01 06:00 UTC :gear:

lina: acceptance criteria proposal: mmap warmup 95p latency regress <4% vs current, streaming path throughput within 8% of current. also must pass zero-copy verification tests.

sophie: perfect. i'll update the RFC doc with the adapter API and add an integration checklist. tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-platform for visibility. :thumbsup:
